# WEEEK

> WEEEK is an all-in-one work management platform combining task management, CRM, knowledge base, and team collaboration tools with integrations for popular services.

WEEEK provides a comprehensive suite of productivity tools designed for teams and individuals to manage projects, tasks, customer relationships, and organizational knowledge. The platform offers native apps across iOS, Android, Windows, and macOS, along with integrations with tools like Google Workspace, Figma, Miro, Slack, and Trello.

## Key Topics

## Core Services

- [Task Manager](https://weeek.net/ru/services/task-manager): WEEEK task manager for project planning and team collaboration
- [CRM System](https://weeek.net/ru/services/crm): WEEEK CRM system for customer and sales management with task integration
- [Knowledge Base](https://weeek.net/ru/services/knowledge-base): WEEEK corporate knowledge base for team documentation and learning
- [Team Management](https://weeek.net/ru/services/users): WEEEK team management and user access control features
